sentences.en: Most athletes are at their best during their early manhood.
sentences.zh: 大多数运动员在年轻时状态最佳。

sentences.en: He is beyond doubt the best athlete in our school.
sentences.zh: 他无疑是学校里最好的运动员。

sentences.en: It seems that he used to be a great athlete.
sentences.zh: 看起来他过去是个很棒的运动员。

senses.zh: 运动员, 田径运动员, 擅长运动的人, 健儿
